subtitle: A practical plan for ticket routing, AI assistance, CRM sync and production monitoring.
job_title: Build an AI-Powered Customer Support Workflow with CRM Integration

items: Your support team handles a growing queue across email and chat, and agents currently read each ticket, decide its category and copy context into the CRM by hand. The result is slower first response, inconsistent routing and customer history that is hard to trust.

The goal is a workflow that classifies incoming requests, surfaces the right help-centre content to an agent, and writes a clean activity record back to the CRM. Success means faster first response, fewer misrouted tickets and a measurable accuracy baseline before any automation is allowed to act without review.

items.title: Map the real queue
items.description: Review 100–200 historical tickets with your team, agree the categories that matter and identify the CRM fields an agent actually uses.

items.title: Design the routing contract
items.description: Define confidence thresholds, fallback to human review, duplicate handling and the exact event payload written back to the CRM.

items.title: Build and calibrate the pilot
items.description: Connect one channel, classify live tickets in shadow mode and compare the model's choices with your team's decisions before enabling routing.

items.title: Harden and hand over
items.description: Add retries, audit logs, permission checks and monitoring, then document how to change categories and investigate a bad classification.

items: Category taxonomy, routing rules and confidence thresholds agreed with your support lead
Working connector for one channel plus CRM activity and contact synchronisation
Shadow-mode evaluation report with accuracy, false-route rate and sample failures
Operator runbook covering retries, escalations, permissions and rollback
Two review sessions with your team and a final handover walkthrough

items: Yes — I can connect to your CRM and helpdesk. Please confirm which platforms and versions are in scope so I can validate the available APIs before the first milestone.
Yes — the pilot can run without sending customer data to an external model. I can start with a local classifier or a redacted payload, and we can agree the data policy before any live traffic.
For the pilot I would target at least 90% agreement with your team on the top five categories, with every low-confidence ticket routed to a human.
